transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: session.start and session.resume read selectedModel. session.model_change reads newModel. session.auto_mode_resolved reads chosenModel. Empty strings are dropped.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: The event is model:updated intent observed with id only. There is no display name and no retract when the field is missing.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: Launch options.model is a separate intent configured event.
